speaker: narrator
text: Before the collapse, Aether-9 never slept.

speaker: narrator
text: Four thousand researchers, and one reactor that drew power from somewhere no one could name.

speaker: narrator
text: We called it the Aether. We thought we were listening to it.

speaker: narrator
text: Then, one night, it answered.

speaker: kael
text: How long has it been?

speaker: lyra
text: Long enough for the city to forget us.

speaker: kael
text: The core shouldn't still be running.

speaker: lyra
text: It isn't running.

speaker: lyra
text: It's waiting.

speaker: kael
text: Giva? Your signal's faint. Where are you?

speaker: lyra
text: North-east side of the plaza. Someone pulled me out of the rain. There are survivors here, Kael.

speaker: kael
text: Stay with them. I'll find you.

speaker: lyra
text: Kael? I can hear you on the link, but you're faint.

speaker: kael
text: North-east corner of the plaza. There are people here. Survivors. They found me in the street.

speaker: lyra
text: Don't move. I'm coming to you.

speaker: kael
text: The monument's still drawing power. That shouldn't be possible.

speaker: lyra
text: The monument's still drawing power. That shouldn't be possible.

speaker: lyra
text: I'm reading it too. There's a pulse in it, repeating. It's a signal, and it's coming from under the city.

speaker: kael
text: I'm reading it too. There's a pulse in it, repeating. It's a signal, and it's coming from under the city.

speaker: kael
text: Movement. Security drones, three of them, coming in fast.

speaker: lyra
text: Movement. Security drones, three of them, coming in fast.

speaker: lyra
text: They're not ours anymore. Be careful.

speaker: kael
text: They're not ours anymore. Be careful.

speaker: kael
text: One of them was carrying something. Concentrated Aether.

speaker: lyra
text: One of them was carrying something. Concentrated Aether.

speaker: lyra
text: An Aether Shard. It'll hit harder for a while. Grab it, then come to the camp.

speaker: kael
text: An Aether Shard. It'll hit harder for a while. Grab it, then come to the camp.

speaker: lyra
text: You took your time.

speaker: kael
text: I stopped to argue with some drones.

speaker: lyra
text: Did you win?

speaker: kael
text: I'm here.

speaker: kael
text: You found me.

speaker: lyra
text: You weren't exactly hiding. Half the city heard those drones go down.

speaker: kael
text: Only half?

speaker: oren
text: Seven years, by my count. That's how long it's been since the Core went quiet.

speaker: lyra
text: This is Oren. He's kept people alive out here.

speaker: oren
text: Kept them hidden, mostly. Those drones used to protect us. Now they protect whatever's down there.

speaker: kael
text: The monument's broadcasting. Something under the city is calling.

speaker: oren
text: The old Line B transit tunnels. Nobody who's gone down there has come back.

speaker: lyra
text: Then we'll be the first.

speaker: maren
text: If this reaches anyone, then the Core kept its promise. Kael. Giva. I'm sorry.

speaker: maren
text: I put you to sleep because you were the only two it would listen to. The resonance keys.

speaker: maren
text: Everything you need is in my lab. Follow the spur line to the facility. My access code is attached.

speaker: maren
text: And don't trust the Guardian. It remembers what I built it to protect. Not why.

speaker: kael
text: My interface just recalibrated. It's pulling Aether through the transmitter.

speaker: lyra
text: My interface just recalibrated. It's pulling Aether through the transmitter.

speaker: lyra
text: Same here. Phasing is online. We can move faster than they can track us now.

speaker: kael
text: Same here. Phasing is online. We can move faster than they can track us now.

speaker: lyra
text: Her research data is talking to my harness. It's tuning itself.

speaker: lyra
text: I can see traces. Echoes of where people were standing when it happened.

speaker: kael
text: Maren's private office isn't on any of these floor plans.

speaker: lyra
text: Then it's hidden. Let me look.

speaker: maren
text: Final entry. The cascade projection was right. In nine minutes the Core will tear itself open and take every one of us with it.

speaker: maren
text: So I'm asking it to hold us. Not our bodies. Our echoes. Everything that makes us who we are.

speaker: maren
text: It said yes. Four thousand people, folded into the Aether. I don't know if it's mercy or a cage.

speaker: maren
text: The Guardian will keep them in. Only a resonance key can tell the Core to let go. That's why I kept you asleep.

speaker: lyra
text: The Echo Collapse wasn't an accident. It was a rescue.

speaker: kael
text: A rescue that never finished.

speaker: lyra
text: Her clearance chip is somewhere in this wing. The Vault is the only way down to the Core.

speaker: lyra
text: She did. Now it's our turn to choose. Her clearance chip is somewhere in this wing.

speaker: kael
text: The Core's resonance. I can feel it in the interface.

speaker: lyra
text: The Core's resonance. I can feel it in the interface.

speaker: lyra
text: We're attuned. Whatever's guarding the Core, we can hit it with the same power it's made of.

speaker: kael
text: We're attuned. Whatever's guarding the Core, we can hit it with the same power it's made of.

speaker: lyra
text: Kael. That's not a sentinel.

speaker: kael
text: It's the thing Maren warned us about.

speaker: guardian
text: Echoes detected. Containment is protection. Return to stasis.

speaker: kael
text: Not a chance.

speaker: lyra
text: The blast door's cycling. We just have to stay alive until it opens!

speaker: maren
text: You came. Both of you. I'm not a recording this time, Giva. I'm one of them.

speaker: lyra
text: Ilse?

speaker: maren
text: Four thousand of us, all holding our breath. The Core doesn't know how to let go on its own. It was built to keep.

speaker: maren
text: The Guardian won't let you near the heart. It thinks it's protecting us. It is me, in a way. The part of me that was afraid.

speaker: kael
text: Then we'll get past it.

speaker: maren
text: It's coming. Hold on.

speaker: guardian
text: Resonance keys. You will not open the heart.

speaker: kael
text: Watch its core. When the plates open, that's our window.

speaker: lyra
text: Watch its core. When the plates open, that's our window.

speaker: lyra
text: Go!

speaker: kael
text: Go!

speaker: maren
text: Thank you. Both of you. We can go now.

speaker: lyra
text: Where will they go?

speaker: kael
text: I don't know. Somewhere they're not waiting anymore.

speaker: narrator
text: For seven years the city held its breath.

speaker: narrator
text: That morning, for the first time since the collapse, the rain stopped over Aether-9.

speaker: lyra
text: What now?

speaker: kael
text: Now we wake the rest of the city.

speaker: lyra
text: The relay's live, but the signal is bouncing off something beneath this roof.

speaker: kael
text: A room that isn't on the plans. Again.

speaker: lyra
text: Echo Sight should pick it up.

speaker: bolt
text: Systems nominal. Hello, Oren.

speaker: oren
text: Hello, old friend. You've been asleep a long time.

speaker: bolt
text: Shield emitter calibrated for new users. Please hold still.

speaker: oren
text: That's his way of saying thank you. Your shields will hold a lot longer now.

speaker: maren
text: You found my last room. I built it in case I was wrong about everything.

speaker: maren
text: The Resonant Core will keep the Guardian's pull off you. Take it. And tell Nia I'm sorry I was late.

speaker: lyra
text: We'll tell her.

speaker: oren
text: Keep your voice down. The drones hunt by sound when they can't see.

speaker: oren
text: That heap by the generator is BOLT. Kept the camp lights on for years before his actuator burned out.

speaker: oren
text: Bring me a servo actuator, a maintenance power cell and a control component, and I'll have him walking again.

speaker: oren
text: Metro maintenance bay for the actuator. The market stalls hid cells under the counters. Control boards, try the rooftop sheds.

speaker: oren
text: Good. He'd do the same for you, if he could.

speaker: oren
text: He's not going anywhere. Neither am I.

speaker: oren
text: Actuator from the metro, power cell from the market, control board from the rooftops. BOLT's patient. I'm less so.

speaker: oren
text: That's all of it. Go on, you do the honours. He'll want to see a new face when he wakes.

speaker: oren
text: BOLT's been walking the perimeter all night. First time I've slept in years.

speaker: mira
text: Shh. I'm listening. There's always something on the band if you're patient.

speaker: mira
text: You two are from before, aren't you? Then maybe you can tell me what this is.

speaker: lyra
text: There's still a transmitter active.

speaker: kael
text: After all this time?

speaker: lyra
text: Someone wanted to be heard.

speaker: kael
text: Then let's listen.

speaker: mira
text: It's the old relay tower above the market. There's a ladder behind the noodle stalls. Will you go?

speaker: mira
text: My sister ran that relay. Anya. She never came home. I know it's stupid to hope.

speaker: mira
text: Thank you. The signal's weak, so you might need to power the relay to trace it properly.

speaker: mira
text: It's been broadcasting for seven years. I suppose it can wait a little longer.

speaker: mira
text: Still there. Still repeating. The relay tower's above the market, past the noodle stalls.

speaker: anya
text: Relay Tower Three, this is Anya Sato. If anyone's out there: the Core isn't killing us. It's keeping us.

speaker: anya
text: Tell Mira I'm still... I'm still listening.

speaker: mira
text: That's her. That's my sister. She stayed on the air until the very end.

speaker: mira
text: Take this. It's her relay tuner. She'd want it on someone who can actually see what she was looking for.

speaker: mira
text: I play her message every night now. It's easier to sleep when someone says goodnight.

speaker: tomas
text: Market's closed, friend. Has been for seven years.

speaker: tomas
text: I trade in memories. People left pieces of themselves all over this city, on little blue recording cores.

speaker: tomas
text: Three of them I've been hunting for years: Market Day, Last Train, and a lullaby someone recorded in the research labs. Find them?

speaker: tomas
text: Because the camp is forgetting what the city sounded like when it was alive. Somebody has to remember for them.

speaker: tomas
text: Look for the blue glow. If Echo Sight is the trick I think it is, some of them will be hiding.

speaker: tomas
text: Market Day, Last Train, Lullaby. The market, the metro and the labs. Three little blue lights.

speaker: tomas
text: You found them. All three.

speaker: vendor
text: Real oranges, from the greenhouse decks! Two credits, and I'm robbing myself!

speaker: tomas
text: I'll play these for the camp tonight. Here, an Aether core. Fair trade for three lifetimes.

speaker: tomas
text: I'd like that. Come back when this is over. There'll be music.

speaker: tomas
text: Always.

speaker: tomas
text: The kids asked me to play the lullaby three times last night. I didn't mind.

speaker: nia
text: You can see me? Everyone stopped seeing me.

speaker: lyra
text: We see you. What's your name?

speaker: nia
text: Nia. My mom worked under the Vault. She said the walls down there sing when nobody's listening.

speaker: nia
text: There's one wall that sings the loudest. She said it was a door. Will you find it for me?

speaker: nia
text: Under the Vault. Listen for the loudest wall.

speaker: nia
text: She said she's sorry she was late? That's okay. She's always late.

speaker: bolt
text: Perimeter secure. Camp morale estimated at forty-one percent. Improving.

speaker: pa
text: Good morning, Aether-9. Line B is running on schedule. Today's resonance index is green.

speaker: pa
text: Remember, the Core does not sleep, so you can. Have a wonderful shift.

speaker: vendor
text: Real oranges, from the greenhouse decks! Two credits, and I'm robbing myself!

speaker: vendor
text: No, no, the lights always flicker on Thursdays. It's the reactor breathing, that's all.

speaker: pa
text: This is the final Line B service of the evening. All passengers, please remain calm.

speaker: pa
text: The tunnel lighting is not malfunctioning. Please remain on the train. Please remain...

speaker: researcher
text: Lab seven, day three-forty. Resonance drift is up four percent. Maren says that's within tolerance.

speaker: researcher
text: I don't think tolerance means what it used to mean around here.

speaker: parent
text: Hush now, the lights went out, that's all. Close your eyes and count the stars we can't see.

speaker: parent
text: One for the Core, two for the city, three for you and me.

speaker: tech
text: Vault watch, end of shift. The Guardian rotated its head toward the lift twice tonight. That's new.

speaker: tech
text: Maren says it's learning. I asked her what it's learning. She didn't answer.

speaker: maren
text: Project Echo, proposal. Aether resonance preserves information. Every pattern that enters the Core is retained, perfectly.

speaker: maren
text: If a pattern can be retained, a mind can be retained. I am requesting authorisation for a controlled trial.

speaker: maren
text: Two staff members show resonance compatibility above ninety percent. Survey lead Voss. Systems engineer Vale.

speaker: maren
text: The Core responds to them the way it responds to nothing else. If anyone can speak to it, they can.

speaker: maren
text: Cascade projection, revision nine. Containment failure is no longer a risk. It is a certainty.

speaker: maren
text: Estimated time to cascade: eleven hours. Evacuation is impossible. There is nowhere to go.

speaker: maren
text: If you're reading this, you found the office. Good. Then you know what I did, and you know what's left to do.

speaker: maren
text: My testament. I chose for four thousand people because there was no time to ask them. Whoever releases them, ask them for me. Ask if I chose right.
